description: Flat record-level metadata schema for iPSC lines studied under varying culture conditions to assess genomic stability using SNP arrays and whole-genome sequencing.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record/sample. Should be stable and unambiguous within the dataset.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or project.

donor_id.descr: Unique identifier for the donor from whom the iPSC line was derived.

donor_age_at_collection_years.descr: Age of the donor at the time the starting sample was collected, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Sex of the donor as recorded; recommended values include male, female, intersex, or unknown.

donor_ethnicity_or_ancestry.descr: Donor ethnicity, ancestry, or population category as recorded; use controlled vocabulary when possible.

donor_phenotypic_notes.descr: Relevant donor clinical or phenotypic notes that may affect interpretation, recorded as free text.

original_cell_type.descr: Original somatic cell type used to derive the iPSC line, for example fibroblast, peripheral blood mononuclear cell, keratinocyte, or urine epithelial cell.

source_sample_id.descr: Identifier for the original source sample used for reprogramming.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate the iPSC line, for example Sendai virus, episomal vectors, mRNA, or integrating vector.

reprogramming_date.descr: Date when reprogramming was initiated or completed, depending on laboratory convention.

ipsc_line_id.descr: Unique identifier for the iPSC line.

clone_id.descr: Identifier for the specific clone if multiple clones were derived from the same donor or line.

line_status.descr: Current status of the line, for example established, expanded, cryopreserved, differentiated, or discarded.

pluripotency_validation_method.descr: Method used to confirm pluripotency, for example marker expression, embryoid body assay, or teratoma assay.

baseline_karyotype_result.descr: Baseline karyotype result prior to experimental culture exposure, for example normal, abnormal, mosaic, or not assessed.

culture_condition_id.descr: Identifier for the specific culture condition applied to the iPSC line.

culture_medium_base.descr: Base medium used for culture, for example mTeSR1, E8, or KnockOut DMEM.

media_supplements.descr: Key medium supplements used, recorded as a semicolon-separated string or controlled list in free-text form if not otherwise structured.

oxygen_concentration_percent.descr: Oxygen concentration during culture, expressed as percent O2 (for example 5, 10, or 21).

temperature_celsius.descr: Incubation temperature in degrees Celsius, typically 37.

co2_concentration_percent.descr: Carbon dioxide concentration in incubator atmosphere, expressed as percent CO2.

passaging_technique.descr: Passaging method used, for example enzymatic dissociation, EDTA, mechanical, or single-cell passaging.

passage_number.descr: Passage number at the time of sampling or measurement.

passage_interval_days.descr: Typical number of days between passages under this condition.

culture_duration_days.descr: Number of days the line was maintained under the recorded culture condition before sampling.

cell_density_at_passage_cells_per_cm2.descr: Approximate cell density at passaging, in cells per square centimeter.

feeder_used.descr: Indicates whether feeder cells were used during culture.

feeder_cell_type.descr: Type of feeder cells used, if applicable, for example mouse embryonic fibroblast.

rock_inhibitor_used.descr: Indicates whether ROCK inhibitor was used during passaging or recovery.

oxygen_variation_notes.descr: Notes describing any planned or unplanned oxygen fluctuations or hypoxia exposure during culture.

medium_change_frequency_days.descr: Interval between medium changes, in days.

incubation_system.descr: Culture system used, for example standard incubator, hypoxia chamber, or automated platform.

batch_id.descr: Identifier for the culture batch or experimental run.

sampling_date.descr: Date when cells were collected for genomic or phenotypic analysis.

sampling_passage_number.descr: Passage number at the time the sample was collected.

sample_type.descr: Type of biological material collected, for example DNA, RNA, live cells, or fixed cells.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition for the collected material, for example fresh, frozen at -80 C, liquid nitrogen, or fixed in paraformaldehyde.

assay_id.descr: Unique identifier for the assay record.

assay_type.descr: Type of genomic integrity assay performed, for example SNP array or whole-genome sequencing.

assay_platform.descr: Instrument or platform used for the assay, for example Illumina CytoSNP, NovaSeq, or similar.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used to extract DNA for genomic analysis.

dna_input_ng.descr: Amount of DNA input used for the assay, in nanograms.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Read length for sequencing assays, in base pairs; use 0 or omit for non-sequencing methods if necessary.

sequencing_coverage_x.descr: Average sequencing coverage or depth, expressed as fold coverage (x); applicable mainly to whole-genome sequencing.

array_resolution.descr: Effective resolution of the SNP array or comparable platform, for example in kilobases or probe count; store as a descriptive string when platform-specific.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome build used for alignment or variant calling, for example GRCh37, GRCh38.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Pipeline, software, or analysis workflow used to detect genomic variants and aberrations.

quality_control_passed.descr: Indicates whether the sample passed assay quality control thresholds.

genetic_aberration_detected.descr: Indicates whether any genetic aberration was detected in the sample.

aberration_count_total.descr: Total number of genetic aberrations detected in the sample.

aberration_type.descr: Primary aberration type detected, for example copy number variant, aneuploidy, single-nucleotide variant, indel, structural variant, or mosaic event.

aberration_chromosome.descr: Chromosome affected by the aberration, if applicable.

aberration_start_position_bp.descr: Start genomic position of the aberration in base pairs, if applicable.

aberration_end_position_bp.descr: End genomic position of the aberration in base pairs, if applicable.

aberration_cytoband.descr: Cytogenetic band designation for the aberration, if applicable.

aberration_gene_names.descr: Gene or genes affected by the aberration, recorded as a string if multiple genes are involved.

aberration_size_bp.descr: Estimated size of the aberration in base pairs, if applicable.

aberration_copy_number_change.descr: Copy number state relative to reference, for example loss, gain, neutral, or amplified.

aberration_mosaic_fraction.descr: Estimated fraction of cells carrying the aberration, expressed from 0 to 1 or as a percentage according to study convention.

aberration_validated.descr: Indicates whether the aberration was confirmed by an independent method.

validation_method.descr: Method used to validate the aberration, for example qPCR, FISH, repeat sequencing, or orthogonal array.

phenotypic_change_observed.descr: Indicates whether any phenotypic change was observed under the recorded culture condition.

phenotype_category.descr: Broad category of phenotypic change, for example morphology, proliferation, viability, differentiation propensity, or stress response.

phenotype_description.descr: Free-text description of the observed phenotype, including severity, timing, and any notable features.

phenotype_assessment_method.descr: Method used to assess phenotype, for example microscopy, growth curve, flow cytometry, or transcriptomics.

phenotype_score.descr: Quantitative score or ordinal rank summarizing phenotype severity if used by the study.

cell_viability_percent.descr: Cell viability under the recorded condition, expressed as percent.

proliferation_rate_doublings_per_day.descr: Estimated proliferation rate, expressed as population doublings per day.

differentiation_marker_change.descr: Observed change in differentiation marker expression, for example upregulated, downregulated, or unchanged.

apoptosis_rate_percent.descr: Percentage of cells undergoing apoptosis under the recorded condition, if measured.

senescence_marker_positive_percent.descr: Percentage of cells positive for senescence markers, if measured.

passaging_stress_notes.descr: Free-text notes on stress during passaging, including clumping, dissociation sensitivity, or cell loss.

experimenter_id.descr: Identifier for the person or core facility performing the culture or assay.

protocol_version.descr: Version identifier for the culture or assay protocol used.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to this record.
